name: hgi_sm_xl2_ctlx

reset_landing.reason: the RTL lands it: rst_n drives one kept async-clear flop rp1 at the S face + 2 plain release flops (ELEM-GAPS/HBMN1 n2/n3, native audit of q1 rst_n capture 455.7 ps); kit landing would add 2 more reset edges

pin_regs.reason: cl2 rule (owner 19:50, 10-15): ctlw RTL registers every leaf pin (issuer cfg/desc pin flops, raw rr capture rr_c, flop-driven rq/c_*/r_*/l_d_o/q*/bsel/lane_en/eg_* outputs); ot_pin_regs would add a second edge per port

floorplan_note: HBM-B 10-17 ctlx: d4f binds ctlw with EGRESS_SPLIT 1, so xw_*/x_done/rwq/bq_d (5,121 of 10,920 pin bits) are open/undriven; ctlx drops them (5,799 pins). Faces follow the d4f neighbours: N rr/rq from the VM banks (vmb_<q>0..7 north of xl_<q>_ctl), E l_d_o to the two quantisers (xl_<q>_aqlo/aqhi east), W the x-store/BD/egress pair bundles, S the host F20 cfg/status + clocks. 388.8^2 (9 x 43.2): N 2,192 pins 5.6/um, E 2,055 5.3/um, W 1,224 3.1/um, S 337. Calendar SRAM SW corner beside its cfg pins and the clk_cal entry; clk entry S mid.
structural_change: ctlw f20a (ba27075db) TT -58.79/FF -11.98: 399 TT paths rr_c/s0r/md -> rotation mux -> ~300 um -> l_d_o; textbook lint high_fanout u_ctl.s0r[26][*] 5,045 loads (opt_merge folded the NR=32 select replicas into one); 11,007 pins at 8-9.5/um on W/E; util 0.14; TT clock insertion 458 / spread 90.8. cl2g (+L1 landing, on main) was never routed. ctlx: cl2g + SEL_KEEP (32 kept select replicas, ot_keep_regs hook) + the die-connected ports only (EGRESS_SPLIT 1: the xw egress datapath and its 5,121 pins leave the tile) + one data clock root (clk_eg = clk as in the XQL binding) + recipe 4 square 388.8 outline.

job.purpose: x-load ctl die master for d4f under XQL (H-SM aeff7691c / 8d98d5225): ctlw EGRESS_SPLIT 1 with the die-connected ports only, kept rotation-select replicas, recipe 4. Replaces xl_<q>_ctl ot_hgi_sm_xload_cl2_ctlw (contract remaster to ot_hgi_sm_xload_cl2_ctlx by H-NETLIST: same edges, the open/undriven xw_*/x_done/rwq/bq_d ports and clk_eg dropped).
